overview: Explore top accredited institutions, tuition costs, eligibility, and visa procedures in Denmark for Computer Engineering (UG) in Denmark.

universities.name: Technical University of Denmark (DTU)
universities.desc: DTU offers BSc and BEng programs in Computer Engineering, with a focus on hardware, electronics, programming and computer systems. Both programs are taught in Danish.

universities.name: Aarhus University
universities.desc: Aarhus University has a bachelor's degree program in Computer Science taught in English. It is a related option for students interested in software, algorithms and computing systems.

universities.name: University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
universities.desc: The University of Southern Denmark offers a bachelor's program in Software Engineering taught in English and is an alternative for students interested in software development and engineering.

universities.name: IT University of Copenhagen
universities.desc: The IT University of Copenhagen offers bachelor's programs with a focus on computing, such as Software Development and Data Science. Students should check the language and program availability for their desired intake date. These programs are not interchangeable. Computer Engineering is generally more hardware- and electronics-oriented, whereas Computer Science and Software Engineering are more software- and computing-systems-oriented. Students should compare the Computer Engineering universities in Denmark and related institutions according to their academic interests and future plans.

items.q: What is the duration of a bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering in Denmark?
items.a: At DTU, the BSc in Computer Engineering is a three-year program. The BEng in Computer Engineering is a three-and-a-half-year degree program, including a six-month internship. Both are taught in Danish.

items.q: Can Indian students study Computer Engineering in Denmark in English?
items.a: There are English-taught options in closely related areas such as Computer Science and Software Engineering. However, DTU's specific Computer Engineering bachelor's programs are Danish-taught, so students should check the language before applying.

items.q: How much does it cost to study Computer Engineering in Denmark?
items.a: That depends on the university. As a rough estimate, tuition fees can range anywhere between ₹5 lakh and ₹15 lakh or more per year, plus living expenses. Exact program fees should be confirmed with the university.

items.q: What are the core subjects in Computer Engineering?
items.a: Mathematics is usually important, and it may be necessary to have physics and other science subjects. The exact subject levels and grades will vary with the course.

items.q: After graduating, are you able to get a job in Denmark?
items.a: Graduates can enter relevant engineering and technology jobs, depending on employer requirements and applicable work-permit and immigration rules. There is no guarantee of employment. Pursuing a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering in Denmark can help students develop knowledge of hardware, software systems, electronics and embedded technologies. However, applicants should carefully compare course content, language of instruction, admission requirements, tuition fees and future study opportunities before selecting a university. For Computer Engineering in Denmark for Indian students, early planning is especially important because some dedicated computer engineering bachelor's programs are taught in Danish, while related computing degrees may offer English-taught options.
